name: APIVerveUnemploymentRate
summary: Unemployment Rate looks up labor statistics by two- or three-letter ISO country code.
description:
Unemployment Rate looks up labor statistics by two- or three-letter ISO country code. It returns the country name, reporting year, and record count, with paid plans adding historical annual rates.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Unemployment Rate from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
